test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: KIFG is related to HFCD in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, AYVW is related to XVST. To which of the given options is CAXY related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed in this pattern involves a consistent alphabetical shift for each letter position:

 
• Each letter shifts **-3** positions backward in the English alphabetical order. (Wrapping around from A to Z as needed).

Let's verify this logic with the given examples:

**For 'KIFG' related to 'HFCD':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a21c6ef8bcf5145fdfe7c121850a291ee7e876555c63b79c6fdfe26b797656e.png] 

**For 'AYVW' related to 'XVST':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3323628709bbe78fb1b00693e02182a0f20840cec71c365aee3b00a10e603ab8.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is: **-3, -3, -3, -3** for each letter position.

**Applying the same logic to 'CAXY':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb34fa4e36e7a7bbf11eb91891d37b57d969e2127178435c4a8c91e37113eeb8.png] 

Thus, 'CAXY' will be coded as **ZXUV**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
